unit.title: The Future, Personal Goals and B1 Integration

theory.title: Future forms and first conditional
theory.explanation: Use will for decisions and predictions, going to for intentions or evidence-based predictions, and present continuous for fixed arrangements. Use the first conditional for real future possibilities: If the plan changes, we'll let you know.
theory.tip: Elige la forma de futuro según intención, evidencia, acuerdo o condición real.

items.prompt: Describe an arrangement you have next week.
items.modelAnswer: During this course, I have become more confident using English in everyday situations. I can describe experiences, explain opinions and ask for information more politely. I have also learned how to talk about plans, solve problems and work with other people. Some grammar points were difficult at first, but regular practice helped me improve. In the future, I would like to use English more often at work and when travelling.

content.audioTranscript: A: How have you found the course? B: Very useful. I've developed new skills and gained more confidence. A: What has helped you most? B: The practical experience and regular practice have made a difference. A: Have you shared your opinions in class? B: Yes, and we've solved several problems together. A: What are your plans for the future? B: I want to achieve my goals and continue making progress.
